title: Rubric - Objectivity
evidence: All criteria are objectively verifiable: file existence criteria (1-3) are binary. ZIP structure criteria (4-5) can be checked by examining the archive contents. Telemetry criteria specify exact formats (MOTION_SAMPLE, ACTION_TRANSITION) with named fields that can be parsed and validated programmatically. Timing criteria (10, 30) specify numeric tolerances (±10%, ±20%). Visual criteria compare against the expected file, which provides an objective reference standard. No criterion uses subjective terms like 'good', 'appropriate', 'well-designed', or 'aesthetically pleasing'. Every criterion has a clear pass/fail determination method.
